blocks.text: 5 Pitt Meadows neighbourhood guides, from Harris Road to the Pitt River

parts.t: One guide for each Pitt Meadows area on my site. Each covers schools, parks, planning, flood notes and what to check before you buy, with a source next to every fact.
Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty. Updated October 18, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate since 2015.
Where a card names a bus route, that guide gives the date of the TransLink timetable I read, so check the current schedule.

blocks.text: Harris Road, Bonson Road and the urban core

parts.t: These follow MLS® sub-area names, which are not City boundaries. The City of Pitt Meadows publishes no boundary for the MLS® sub-areas these guides cover, and Mid and South Meadows overlap along Bonson Road.
Harris Road, the West Coast Express station, the civic centre, Pitt Meadows Elementary, the heritage register and the Town Centre plan.
Bonson Road, Edith McDermott and Davie Jones elementary schools, the Athletic Park and arena, buses 722, 719 and 701 and flood notes.
The South Bonson Community Centre and art gallery, Shoreline Park, Bonson Park, Fraser Way buses and flood notes.

Questions about a Pitt Meadows area? Call or text
Which Pitt Meadows areas have a guide?
Do these areas have official boundaries?

The names are MLS® sub-areas, which the City of Pitt Meadows does not publish as boundaries. Each guide says how it places its area and gives facts by street address. Mid Meadows and South Meadows overlap along Bonson Road, so read both if your address is near it.
Which guide covers Harris Road and the West Coast Express?
covers Harris Road, the civic centre and Pitt Meadows Station.
How do I check the school for an address?
Pitt Meadows public schools are run by School District 42 (SD42). Catchments are set by address, so confirm an exact address with
. Pitt Meadows Secondary is the only public secondary school in Pitt Meadows on the Province’s school list, and each guide lists the elementary schools I found for its area.
Do the guides have flood notes?
Yes. Each guide has a flood section from City pages. The City says it is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes and is at risk of flooding annually in May and June (
City of Pitt Meadows dikes page
). Ask me or the City about a specific lot.
The City says 78% of Pitt Meadows land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve. ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
. Each guide says what I found for its area.
Can you check a Pitt Meadows address for me?
Yes. Send me the address with the form below. I’ll look up its zone, plan designation and any ALR or flood questions and get back to you before you write an offer.
